items.quote: Moreover he said, I am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.
items.claim: The speaker says he is the God of the addressee's father, and the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

items.quote: And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.
items.claim: Moses hid his face because he was afraid to look at God.
